title: £1.46 Million Refinance
h1: Not revealed by search snippets. The result link title is "£1.46 Million Refinance"; the slug implies a longer heading such as "£1.46 Million Refinance – Prime Central London Property" but this was not shown.
summary: Case study of a £1.46 million refinance of an unencumbered residential property in Prime Central London, arranged by Silver Oak Capital. Purpose: the client needed funds to reimburse family members who had privately contributed to the purchase and refurbishment of the property, a loan purpose the write-up says fell outside typical lending criteria. Borrower: a single-name owner whose affordability relied on multiple household incomes, supported by a personal guarantee from an overseas high-net-worth individual with no UK footprint; documentation spanned several jurisdictions. Outcome: a £1.46 million, 5-year interest-only facility at a conservative loan-to-value, with a lender who accepted the non-standard purpose, the combined household income and an international guarantor with verified offshore income. The transaction also included onboarding the client into a new private banking relationship (lender type therefore appears to be a private bank, though no lender is named). Exact LTV, rate, fees, timing/completion date, lender name and borrower nationality are not revealed in the snippets.
